item.title: Spelling
item.description:
• ]s: Next misspelled word
  • [s: Previously misspelled word
  • z=: Show suggestions for the current word
  • zg: Add the word to the dictionary
  • zw: Mark a word as incorrect

item.title: Tips and Tricks
item.description:
Available shortcuts

dl is equivalent to x. So x could be a very nice available key (like s).

Leap

require('leap.user').set_repeat_keys('<enter>', '<backspace>')

Two options that I will need for Ambre’s computer:

  • leap.opts.safe_labels→ Keys that you would never use after a jump

    These should be keys that you would never use right after a jump, so that the plugin can instantly jump to the first match when this safe list covers the rest. → j’ai rajouté la lettre s pour pouvoir arriver sur un mot, et le “surrounder”.
